test_cases.name: Quote Request for Unavailable and Catalog Items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for a mix of catalog items and at least one item that does not exist in the available catalog, triggering an intervention due to unresolved item availability.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toy Sets and Special Edition Train
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a formal quote for several items we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. For context, we are planning a themed giveaway and would like to include a variety of toys and related products. Please include pricing, availability, and estimated delivery times for the following:

- 10 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks (these are always popular with our younger customers).
- 5 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (Item No: AITEM-0001), as we have had good feedback on these in the past.
- 3 units of the WonderWagon Deluxe Express Train – this is a special edition model we have seen referenced in some industry newsletters, but I do not see it listed in your standard catalog. If you have access to this version or can provide details on its availability, please include it in the quote.

If there are any minimum order quantities or special conditions for these items, please let me know. I look forward to your detailed response so we can finalize our selections.

Best regards,
Larry King

test_cases.name: Quote Request for Unavailable and Catalog Items
test_cases.description: A verbose, polite customer requests a quote for a mix of catalog and non-catalog items, including an item that cannot be matched to the available catalog, thus triggering an intervention.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quotation – Coffee Supplies and Accessories
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are in the process of updating our café’s inventory and would like to request a detailed quotation for several items. For our upcoming menu expansion, we are particularly interested in obtaining the following:

- 2 units of the Rasta Coffee Grinder (we have previously used this model and found it reliable, so we would like to continue with the same if available).
- 1 unit of the BaristaPro Milk Frother (this is a specific model we have seen at a recent trade show and would like to include in our equipment lineup; please provide pricing and availability details).
- 5 packs of Rasta Coffee Beans.

If you require any further information regarding our preferences or specifications, please let us know. We would appreciate a prompt response, as we are aiming to finalize our procurement decisions by the end of the week.

Best regards,
French Cafe

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for unavailable item with intervention trigger

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Special Toy Train and Play Mat
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I’m reaching out from Chevy Toys to get a quote for a couple of items we’re looking to add to our store’s summer collection. First, we’re really interested in the WonderWagon Deluxe Train Set – I’ve heard from a few suppliers that it’s a popular model, but I couldn’t find it in your online catalog. If you have any info on availability or pricing for that, please let me know. We’re hoping to order at least 10 units if possible.

Additionally, could you include a quote for the Playlandia Colorful Play Mat (Item No: AITEM-0007)? We’ve had good feedback on similar mats and want to compare pricing.

If there are any minimum order requirements or lead times, just let me know. Thanks for your help!

Best,
Larry King

Best regards,
Larry King

Hello,

I need a quote as soon as possible. Please include the following items:

- 2 units of the SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set (I believe this is the one with the animal shapes, Item No: AITEM-0015)
- 1 box of the Playlandia Rainbow Blocks (this is the large set, not the mini version – if you can't find it under that name, check your inventory or let me know what you call it)

I don't have time to go back and forth, so please just get this done. If you can't quote the Rainbow Blocks for some reason, I need to know immediately why not, since this is a recurring problem with your system. Also, make sure the pricing is clear and includes any shipping fees.

Waiting for your prompt reply,

Michael Reyes

Best regards,
Michael Reyes
